why_worth_it: Gyeongju is an open-air museum city — grass burial mounds sitting in the middle of the modern town.
food_drink_pick: Jeonju bibimbap (the original), kongnamul gukbap; Gyeongju bread
best_time: Donggung Palace and Wolji Pond illuminated at night is the best photo in Korea outside blossom season.

specific_attraction: Gamcheon Culture Village, Haedong Yonggungsa cliff temple, Jagalchi fish market, Haeundae beach, Songdo skywalk
why_worth_it: Haedong Yonggungsa is one of very few Korean temples built on the sea rather than in the mountains.
food_drink_pick: Dwaeji gukbap (pork soup — Busan's dish), raw fish at Jagalchi, ssiat hotteok
best_time: Gamcheon is a real residential neighbourhood, not a set. Keep noise down and don't photograph into windows.

specific_attraction: Taipei 101, Elephant Mountain at sunset, Raohe and Shilin night markets, Beitou hot springs, Chiang Kai-shek Memorial
why_worth_it: Elephant Mountain is a 20-minute stair climb for the definitive Taipei 101 skyline shot — go 45 min before sunset.
food_drink_pick: Beef noodle soup, pepper buns at Raohe, xiaolongbao at Din Tai Fung's original, bubble tea (invented here)
best_time: Beitou's public hot springs are a 25-min metro ride from central Taipei — the easiest onsen-equivalent in Asia.

specific_attraction: Jiufen Old Street teahouses at dusk, Shifen sky lanterns; Taroko Gorge marble canyon, Qingshui Cliffs
why_worth_it: Jiufen's lantern-lit stepped street at dusk is the famous one; Taroko is a marble gorge with a road cut through it and it is spectacular.
food_drink_pick: Taro balls in Jiufen; Hualien mochi; aboriginal cuisine on the east coast
best_time: Taroko Gorge sustained major damage in the April 2024 Hualien earthquake and access has been restricted since. VERIFY which trails and roads are open before committing this leg.

specific_attraction: Tainan's Anping Fort and temple food; Kaohsiung's Lotus Pond, Pier-2 Art Center, Fo Guang Shan
why_worth_it: Tainan is Taiwan's oldest city and its best food city — locals travel there specifically to eat.
food_drink_pick: Tainan danzai noodles, coffin bread, milkfish congee, shrimp rolls
best_time: If you only have one southern stop, make it Tainan for food and treat Kaohsiung as the airport.

specific_attraction: Forbidden City, Temple of Heaven, Mutianyu Great Wall, hutongs, Summer Palace, 798 Art District
why_worth_it: Mutianyu is the restored-but-not-mobbed Great Wall section — cable car up, toboggan down.
food_drink_pick: Peking duck (Siji Minfu over the tourist chains), jianbing for breakfast, Wangfujing snack street
best_time: Forbidden City requires advance online reservation with passport, caps daily numbers, and closes Mondays. Book the moment your dates are fixed.

specific_attraction: Zhangjiajie National Forest Park sandstone pillars, Bailong glass elevator, Tianmen Mountain glass walkway
why_worth_it: The quartz-sandstone pillars that inspired Avatar's floating mountains. The Bailong elevator is a 326m outdoor lift bolted to a cliff.
food_drink_pick: Hunan cuisine — genuinely spicy; smoked pork with chilli
best_time: Go at opening. Mist is common and can erase the view entirely — build in a buffer day if this is the reason you came.

specific_attraction: Li River cruise, Yulong River bamboo raft, Xianggong Hill sunrise, cycling the countryside, Longji rice terraces
why_worth_it: Xianggong Hill at sunrise over the Li River bend is one of the great landscape views in Asia and takes a 20-minute climb.
food_drink_pick: Yangshuo beer fish; Guilin rice noodles for breakfast
best_time: Rent a bike or e-bike and ride the Yulong River road — that's the actual Yangshuo experience, not the town's West Street.

specific_attraction: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding, Jinli and Kuanzhai alleys, Leshan Giant Buddha; Chongqing's Hongyadong and the Liziba monorail-through-a-building
why_worth_it: Pandas are most active right at opening. Chongqing's Liziba station runs a metro train straight through a residential tower — a genuinely bizarre piece of civil engineering.
food_drink_pick: Chengdu hotpot and mapo tofu; Chongqing xiaomian noodles
best_time: Panda base at 08:00 sharp. By 10:00 they're asleep and the crowds have arrived.

specific_attraction: The Bund at night, Pudong skyline, Yu Garden, French Concession, Shanghai Tower observation deck, Tianzifang
why_worth_it: The Bund's colonial waterfront facing Pudong's skyline across the river is the single best urban contrast in Asia.
food_drink_pick: Xiaolongbao at Jia Jia Tang Bao, shengjianbao, hairy crab in autumn
best_time: Fly this leg, don't take the 11h train. Also ride the Maglev from Pudong airport — 431 km/h, and it takes 7 minutes.

specific_attraction: West Lake by bike at sunrise, then Songcheng Park's "Romance of the Song Dynasty" evening show, famous for its rotating and rising stage sections
why_worth_it: This is the large scale theatrical stage show with the moving, rotating set pieces; a genuinely different kind of spectacle from a Western show, and Hangzhou is a short high speed rail hop from Shanghai.
food_drink_pick: West Lake vinegar fish, Longjing tea in a lakeside teahouse
best_time: Year round, show times VERIFY before booking

specific_attraction: Forbidden City, Temple of Heaven, Mutianyu Great Wall, Summer Palace, hutongs
why_worth_it: Start the chronology at the Ming/Qing end and work backwards — it makes the earlier sites read more clearly.
food_drink_pick: Peking duck; zhajiangmian
best_time: Forbidden City: passport-linked advance booking, capped, closed Mondays.

specific_attraction: Yungang Grottoes, Hanging Monastery (Xuankong Si), Datong city walls
why_worth_it: Yungang holds 51,000 statues carved into sandstone from the 5th century — earlier than Longmen and far less crowded. The Hanging Monastery is built onto a cliff face on wooden beams.
food_drink_pick: Shanxi knife-shaved noodles (dao xiao mian); vinegar is the regional obsession
best_time: This is the single most underrated major site in China. Solo-only — the partner version cuts it for transit cost.

specific_attraction: Pingyao Ancient City walls, Rishengchang (China's first bank), Ming-Qing street, courtyard inn stay
why_worth_it: A completely intact Ming/Qing walled city — the only one at this scale. Rishengchang was the origin of Chinese banking.
food_drink_pick: Pingyao beef; Shanxi noodles; aged vinegar
best_time: Stay inside the walls in a courtyard inn. The city is genuinely atmospheric after the day-trippers leave.

specific_attraction: Terracotta Army, Xi'an city wall by bicycle, Muslim Quarter, Big Wild Goose Pagoda, Han Yang Ling
why_worth_it: Pit 1 is the one everyone photographs, but Pit 3 (the command post) and the bronze chariots hall are where the archaeology gets interesting.
food_drink_pick: Roujiamo (Chinese hamburger), biangbiang noodles, yangrou paomo in the Muslim Quarter
best_time: Cycle the full 13.7km city wall circuit at sunset — best hour in Xi'an. A guide at the Terracotta Army is genuinely worth it.

specific_attraction: Longmen Grottoes, White Horse Temple, Shaolin Temple and the Pagoda Forest at Dengfeng
why_worth_it: Longmen's Vairocana Buddha is 17m tall and carved directly into the limestone cliff above the Yi River. The Pagoda Forest at Shaolin holds 240+ funerary pagodas across a millennium.
food_drink_pick: Luoyang water banquet (a 24-course soup sequence); peony-themed everything in April
best_time: Approach Longmen from the east bank first for the best light on the main niche.

specific_attraction: Nanjing Ming city wall and Massacre Memorial; Suzhou's Humble Administrator's Garden and Lingering Garden; Shanghai Bund
why_worth_it: Suzhou's gardens are the most sophisticated designed spaces in China — borrowed scenery, framed views, and deliberately controlled sightlines.
food_drink_pick: Suzhou sweet-braised pork, Nanjing salted duck, Shanghai xiaolongbao
best_time: Go to the Humble Administrator's Garden at opening. It's designed for solitude and doesn't survive a crowd.

specific_attraction: Ding ding tram, upper deck front seat, Kennedy Town → Causeway Bay end to end
why_worth_it: The cheapest and best orientation to the city — an hour of street-level Hong Kong for the price of nothing, in a 120-year-old double-decker tram.
food_drink_pick: Cha chaan teng lunch: milk tea, pineapple bun with a cold butter slab, macaroni soup
best_time: Octopus card first, at the airport. It works on the tram, MTR, ferries and in convenience stores.

specific_attraction: Man Mo Temple, then the Tai Ping Shan / PoHo streets and Hollywood Road antiques
why_worth_it: Incense coils hanging from the ceiling in a temple wedged between tower blocks — the compression of old and new that defines the city.
food_drink_pick: Egg tarts at a neighbourhood bakery
best_time: Tai Kwun, the converted former police headquarters and prison, is ten minutes away and free to enter.

specific_attraction: Lugard Road loop walk at sunset (walk or Peak Tram up, walk the loop, skip the paid deck)
why_worth_it: A flat 3.5km circuit around the mountain with the full harbour laid out below. Free, and the better composition compared to the ticketed platform.
best_time: Peak Tram queues are long; the bus or a taxi up is often faster. Stay for blue hour — the skyline switches on.

specific_attraction: Star Ferry crossing, upper deck, then the TST waterfront promenade
why_worth_it: Eight minutes across Victoria Harbour for around HK$5. Cheaper than the metro and it's the view every harbour cruise sells.
best_time: The Symphony of Lights show is visible free from this promenade — no cruise ticket needed.

specific_attraction: Apliu Street electronics flea market + Golden Computer Arcade
why_worth_it: Loose components, test equipment, salvaged boards, connectors and cable by the bin — plus fabric and buttons two streets over. One of the great remaining electronics bazaars.
food_drink_pick: Tim Ho Wan or a local cha chaan teng; sweet tofu pudding at Kung Wo Dou Bun Chong
best_time: Cash and patience. Bargaining is normal. Given the Node-01 build, budget more time here than you think you need.

specific_attraction: Temple Street night market + a dai pai dong dinner
why_worth_it: Open-air street stalls, clay-pot rice, and the last of the old outdoor cooking licences.
food_drink_pick: Clay-pot rice; typhoon-shelter crab
best_time: The market has shrunk considerably over the years. Go for the food stalls, not the goods.

route: Shau Kei Wan → Dragon's Back → Tung Chung
specific_attraction: Dragon's Back ridge hike at first light
address: To Tei Wan, Shek O Rd
why_worth_it: A ridgeline trail with the South China Sea on both sides, finishing at a beach. Around 8km, genuinely easy, and 40 minutes from the financial district.
food_drink_pick: Beach shack noodles at Big Wave Bay
best_time: Hong Kong is roughly three-quarters country park. This surprises almost every first-time visitor.

route: Shau Kei Wan → Dragon's Back → Tung Chung
specific_attraction: Ngong Ping cable car → Tian Tan Buddha → Tai O stilt village
why_worth_it: A 25-minute cable car over the mountains, then a fishing village built on stilts over a tidal creek — the last of its kind here.
food_drink_pick: Tai O shrimp paste; grilled squid on the waterfront
best_time: The crystal-floor cabin is worth the upgrade. Cable car closes in high wind — VERIFY on the day.

specific_attraction: Senado Square → Ruins of St Paul's → Monte Fort → the back lanes of St Lazarus
why_worth_it: A Portuguese colonial town centre grafted onto a Cantonese city — pastel façades, azulejo tiles, Catholic churches and Chinese temples on the same block.
food_drink_pick: Portuguese egg tart at Lord Stow's or Margaret's; pork chop bun; almond cookies
best_time: PASSPORT REQUIRED — Macau is a separate immigration checkpoint. The historic centre is UNESCO-listed.

specific_attraction: Taipa Village old streets and Coloane
why_worth_it: The quieter, more intact colonial village, and Coloane beyond it is close to rural.
food_drink_pick: Macanese food — minchi, African chicken, bacalhau
best_time: Macanese cuisine is a genuine Portuguese-Cantonese-Malaccan hybrid found essentially nowhere else. Don't skip it for a casino buffet.

specific_attraction: Yung Shue Wan → Sok Kwu Wan family walk + seafood lunch
why_worth_it: A car-free island 30 minutes from Central. A gentle hour's walk between two fishing villages, ending at a waterfront seafood lunch.
food_drink_pick: Steamed garlic scallops, salt-and-pepper squid
best_time: Cheung Chau is the busier alternative with a beach and better street food. Pick one, not both.

specific_attraction: Last dim sum, then Airport Express
why_worth_it: Dim sum is a morning-to-early-afternoon meal here, not an evening one. A serious house does trolley or order-slip service.
food_drink_pick: Har gow, siu mai, cheung fun, lo mai gai, egg tart
best_time: Several famous old tea houses have closed or changed hands in recent years — confirm your pick is still trading before building a morning around it.

specific_attraction: Old Quarter walk, Train Street (VERIFY access), Hoan Kiem, Temple of Literature, bia hoi corner
why_worth_it: Hanoi's Old Quarter is the densest street-food environment in Asia — plan by dish, not by restaurant.
food_drink_pick: Bun cha (Huong Lien), egg coffee at Giang Café, banh mi 25, bia hoi at 25c a glass
best_time: Train Street cafés have been repeatedly closed and reopened by authorities. VERIFY status; never stand on the tracks outside a café's designated area.

specific_attraction: Overnight junk cruise, kayaking through karst caves, Cat Ba
why_worth_it: Lan Ha Bay gives the same limestone karst scenery with a fraction of the boat traffic.
food_drink_pick: Fresh seafood on board
best_time: Cruises cancel in storms and the bay closes in typhoons. Book a mid-tier or better operator — the cheapest boats are genuinely unpleasant.

specific_attraction: Ancient Town lanterns, An Bang beach, Ba Na Hills Golden Bridge, tailoring, Hai Van Pass
why_worth_it: The lantern-lit riverfront after dark is the best evening in Vietnam. Get clothes tailored on day one so they're ready on day three.
food_drink_pick: Cao lau (only made with local well water), white rose dumplings, banh mi Phuong, and a Hoi An egg coffee or a cold Mot herbal drink on the corner
best_time: The green Mot drink stand near the Japanese Bridge is the specific Hoi An drink — herbal, iced, about 20,000 VND, and genuinely good.

specific_attraction: War Remnants Museum, Cu Chi tunnels, Ben Thanh, rooftop bars, Binh Tay market
why_worth_it: The War Remnants Museum is confronting and essential. Cu Chi is a half-day out.
food_drink_pick: Com tam, banh xeo, ca phe sua da, a bowl of pho at a plastic-stool place
best_time: HCMC traffic is the most intense in the region — use Grab bike, not walking, for anything over 1km.

specific_attraction: Angkor Wat sunrise, Bayon faces, Ta Prohm, Banteay Srei, Angkor Thom
why_worth_it: Angkor Wat at sunrise is genuinely worth the 04:30 alarm once. Ta Prohm's strangler figs are the Tomb Raider temple.
food_drink_pick: Fish amok, Khmer red curry, Cambodian pepper crab
best_time: Buy the multi-day pass at the official ticket centre or online. A licensed guide is genuinely worth it here — the iconography is unreadable without one.

specific_attraction: Grand Palace, Wat Pho, Wat Arun, Chatuchak (weekends), Chinatown food, rooftop bars
why_worth_it: Yaowarat (Chinatown) after dark is the best street-food street in the world, full stop.
food_drink_pick: Boat noodles, mango sticky rice, Jay Fai if you can get in, pad krapow from a stall
best_time: Grand Palace has a strict dress code (covered shoulders and knees) and is strictly enforced.

specific_attraction: Old City temples, Doi Suthep, ethical elephant sanctuary, Sunday Walking Street, cooking class
why_worth_it: A half-day Thai cooking class here is the single best-value activity in Southeast Asia.
food_drink_pick: Khao soi (the northern curry noodle — this is THE Chiang Mai dish), sai ua sausage
best_time: Choose an elephant sanctuary with no riding and no bathing-with-tourists — the genuinely ethical ones observe only.

specific_attraction: Trang An boat ride, Hang Mua viewpoint steps, Bich Dong pagoda, cycling through rice paddies
why_worth_it: Rowed by foot through flooded karst caves. It's Ha Long Bay's scenery without the cruise-quality gamble, and it's rural and quiet.
food_drink_pick: Goat meat (de nui) — the local speciality; com chay crispy rice
best_time: Trang An's route 3 is the longest and least crowded. Hang Mua's 500 steps at sunrise is the viewpoint.

specific_attraction: Old Quarter food walk, egg coffee, water puppet theatre, French Quarter architecture
why_worth_it: Two nights is right — enough for the food, not so long that the traffic wears you down.
food_drink_pick: Bun cha, cha ca la vong, egg coffee at Giang
best_time: A guided evening street-food walk on night one makes the rest of the trip's eating far better.

specific_attraction: Ancient Town lanterns, tailoring, An Bang beach days, Tra Que herb village, cooking class, Hai Van Pass drive
why_worth_it: Four nights turns Hoi An from a photo stop into the best part of the trip: mornings on the beach, afternoons in the tailor's, evenings on the lantern-lit river.
food_drink_pick: Cao lau, white rose dumplings, banh mi Phuong, and the green herbal Mot drink near the Japanese Bridge
best_time: Order tailoring on arrival day. The Hai Van Pass by private car (or the Hue train segment) is a spectacular half-day.

specific_attraction: Cooking class, ethical elephant observation sanctuary, Doi Suthep at sunset, Nimman cafés
why_worth_it: Northern Thailand is cooler, greener and far calmer than Bangkok — the right partner-trip Thailand.
food_drink_pick: Khao soi, sai ua, mango sticky rice, a Nimman specialty-coffee morning
best_time: Feb–Apr is northern Thailand's burning season with genuinely poor air quality. VERIFY AQI forecasts — this can be a reason to shift dates.

specific_attraction: Wat Pho + Wat Arun at sunset, Chao Phraya river boat, Yaowarat food night, one rooftop bar
why_worth_it: Two nights, done as river + temples + one great food night, is the correct amount of Bangkok for this trip.
food_drink_pick: Yaowarat street seafood, boat noodles, mango sticky rice
best_time: Take the public Chao Phraya express boat rather than a tourist cruise — same view, a tenth of the price, more interesting.

specific_attraction: Burj Khalifa At the Top, Dubai Mall fountain, Al Fahidi historic district, abra across the Creek, Gold and Spice souks, desert dune-bashing
why_worth_it: The 1 AED abra ride across Dubai Creek is the best-value thing in the city and puts the old town and the skyline in one frame.
food_drink_pick: Al Ustad Special Kebab (Iranian, since 1978); karak chai; Ravi Restaurant in Satwa
best_time: Burj Khalifa sunset slots sell out days ahead and cost roughly double the off-peak slots.

specific_attraction: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Louvre Abu Dhabi, Qasr Al Watan
why_worth_it: The Grand Mosque is genuinely one of the most beautiful buildings constructed in the last century, and Nouvel's Louvre dome creates a 'rain of light' effect.
food_drink_pick: Emirati machboos; luqaimat
best_time: Strict dress code at the mosque: ankles, wrists and hair covered for women; long trousers for men. Abayas are provided free.

specific_attraction: Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque, Mutrah Souq and Corniche, Royal Opera House, Wadi Shab, Bimmah Sinkhole
why_worth_it: Wadi Shab requires a short boat, a 45-minute walk and a swim through a rock cleft into a hidden waterfall chamber. Genuinely one of the best half-days in Arabia.
food_drink_pick: Omani shuwa (slow-cooked lamb); halwa with kahwa
best_time: Bring a dry bag for Wadi Shab — you swim the last section with your belongings.

specific_attraction: Nizwa Fort and Friday goat market, Jebel Akhdar terraces, Wahiba Sands desert camp, Jebel Shams canyon
why_worth_it: Jebel Shams is the 'Grand Canyon of Arabia' and the balcony walk along the rim is a genuinely spectacular and little-visited hike.
food_drink_pick: Dates and kahwa at a desert camp; fresh Omani bread
best_time: Nizwa's livestock market runs Friday mornings only — it's the real thing, not a show. Plan the week around it.

specific_attraction: Petra: the Siq, Treasury, Monastery climb, Petra by Night; Wadi Rum 4×4 and overnight camp; Jerash Roman city
why_worth_it: The Monastery (Ad Deir) is 800+ steps above the main site and most day-trippers never get there — it's larger than the Treasury and almost empty.
food_drink_pick: Mansaf (Jordan's national dish); knafeh in Amman; Bedouin zarb cooked underground
best_time: The Jordan Pass bundles multi-day Petra entry with the tourist visa fee and usually saves money — buy it before you fly. Petra by Night runs on specific evenings only; VERIFY the schedule.

specific_attraction: Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Basilica Cistern, Grand Bazaar, Bosphorus ferry; Cappadocia balloons, Göreme, underground cities
why_worth_it: The Bosphorus public ferry between two continents for the price of a transit fare is one of the great cheap travel experiences. Cappadocia's balloon launch at dawn is worth the 04:30 alarm.
food_drink_pick: Balık ekmek by the Galata Bridge, Turkish breakfast, testi kebab in Cappadocia
best_time: Balloons cancel for wind with no notice. Book the first morning of a 3-night stay so you have two backup mornings.

specific_attraction: Pyramids of Giza and the Sphinx, Grand Egyptian Museum, Saqqara step pyramid, Islamic Cairo (Ibn Tulun, Sultan Hassan, Al-Muizz street), Khan el-Khalili
why_worth_it: Saqqara's Step Pyramid of Djoser is the oldest large stone building on earth and is far quieter than Giza. The Grand Egyptian Museum holds the complete Tutankhamun collection together for the first time.
food_drink_pick: Koshari (Abou Tarek), ful and taameya breakfast, mango juice
best_time: VERIFY the Grand Egyptian Museum's current opening scope and ticketing — its phased opening has changed repeatedly. Book Giza for opening hour; agree all camel/guide prices in writing before starting.

specific_attraction: Karnak Temple, Luxor Temple at night, Valley of the Kings (incl. a premium tomb), Hatshepsut, Medinet Habu, hot-air balloon at dawn
why_worth_it: Medinet Habu retains its original paint in places and gets a fraction of the Valley of the Kings crowd. Karnak's hypostyle hall is 134 columns and genuinely overwhelming.
food_drink_pick: Egyptian tagine; sugarcane juice
best_time: Base ticket covers three tombs; Seti I and Nefertari are separate premium tickets and Nefertari's painted chamber is the best-preserved in Egypt. Worth the cost once.

specific_attraction: Edfu (Temple of Horus), Kom Ombo (double temple), Esna lock, felucca sailing
why_worth_it: Edfu is the best-preserved temple in Egypt — roof intact, walls complete. It's a cruise stop and hard to reach otherwise.
food_drink_pick: On-board Egyptian buffet; hibiscus karkade
best_time: A dahabiya (small sailing boat, ~10 guests) costs more but is a completely different and better experience than a 150-cabin cruise ship.

transport: Road convoy or flight to Abu Simbel
specific_attraction: Abu Simbel, Philae Temple, Nubian village, Old Cataract hotel terrace, Unfinished Obelisk
why_worth_it: Both Abu Simbel and Philae were physically relocated to escape the Aswan High Dam reservoir. That 1960s salvage engineering is as remarkable as the temples.
food_drink_pick: Nubian food in a Nubian village; karkade
best_time: Leave Aswan by 04:00 for Abu Simbel to arrive before the heat and the coach convoy.

specific_attraction: Jerash Roman city, Amman citadel, King's Highway (Madaba mosaics, Mount Nebo, Kerak), Petra: Siq, Treasury, Monastery, High Place of Sacrifice
why_worth_it: Jerash's oval forum and colonnaded cardo are the best-preserved Roman provincial streetscape outside Italy. Petra's High Place of Sacrifice gives the overhead view of the whole valley.
food_drink_pick: Mansaf, knafeh nabulsieh in Amman, Bedouin tea in Petra
best_time: Buy the Jordan Pass before flying — it covers the visa fee plus multi-day Petra entry. Enter Petra at 06:00 to have the Siq and Treasury near-empty.

specific_attraction: Briefing, gear check, Tarangire NP en route
why_worth_it: Tarangire has the highest elephant density in northern Tanzania and huge baobabs — a strong first park before the Serengeti.
food_drink_pick: Nyama choma; ugali
best_time: Confirm your operator is TALA-licensed and ask specifically about vehicle type — a pop-top 4×4 with a window seat guaranteed per person matters a lot over 5 days.

specific_attraction: Game drives, migration herds, big-cat tracking, optional hot-air balloon at dawn
why_worth_it: The balloon flight over the Serengeti at dawn, landing to a bush breakfast, is expensive and genuinely one of the great travel experiences.
food_drink_pick: Bush breakfast after the balloon landing
best_time: Migration position varies by month and by rainfall. VERIFY with your operator where the herds actually are for your dates before choosing which part of the Serengeti to camp in.

specific_attraction: Ngorongoro Crater floor game drive; Olduvai Gorge
why_worth_it: A collapsed caldera 600m deep holding roughly 25,000 large animals in a closed ecosystem, including one of the last black rhino populations. Olduvai nearby is where the Leakeys found the hominin fossils.
best_time: Crater descent is permitted for a limited time window per vehicle. Start at dawn — the crater floor fogs and then fills with vehicles by 10:00.

specific_attraction: Mountain gorilla trek, golden monkey trek, Dian Fossey tomb hike, Kigali Genocide Memorial
why_worth_it: One hour with a habituated gorilla family at 3,000m in bamboo forest. There are roughly 1,000 mountain gorillas left and the permit fee funds their protection directly.
food_drink_pick: Rwandan coffee — genuinely world-class
best_time: VERIFY the current permit price and availability — permits are capped at 8 people per gorilla family per day and book months ahead. You'll be refused if you're visibly ill; gorillas catch human respiratory viruses. The Kigali Genocide Memorial is essential and free.

specific_attraction: Stone Town, spice farm, Prison Island, Nungwi beach, sunset dhow, Jozani forest red colobus
why_worth_it: Stone Town is a UNESCO Swahili-Arab-Indian trading port with carved doors and a labyrinth of lanes — genuine history attached to the beach week.
food_drink_pick: Zanzibar pizza and urojo at Forodhani night market; pilau; fresh octopus
best_time: Zanzibar is majority Muslim — dress modestly outside beach resorts. A separate mandatory travel insurance requirement has applied to visitors; VERIFY current status.

specific_attraction: Arrival buffer: Table Mountain, Kirstenbosch, Bo-Kaap before the placement starts
why_worth_it: Arrive 1–2 days early so a delayed flight doesn't cost you the programme induction.
food_drink_pick: Cape Malay curry in Bo-Kaap; a Stellenbosch wine lunch
best_time: Always build a buffer day in front of a placement start date. Always.

specific_attraction: Induction, safety briefing, species ID training, data-protocol training
why_worth_it: The first two days are training. Ask upfront what proportion of the placement is data collection versus general reserve maintenance — the ratio tells you what kind of programme it really is.
food_drink_pick: Programme catering
best_time: Bring your own laptop and offer to help with the data pipeline. It's the fastest way to be given more interesting work.

specific_attraction: Telemetry tracking, camera-trap servicing and image processing, transect counts, ID database updates, night drives
why_worth_it: Camera-trap servicing and image classification is where an engineering background becomes obviously useful — most volunteers can't automate anything, and the backlog is always enormous.
best_time: Keep your own field notebook and ask whether you can be credited or acknowledged in any output. Ask early; it's awkward to ask on the last day.

specific_attraction: Tsitsikamma, Knysna Heads, Storms River suspension bridge, Hermanus whale watching in season
why_worth_it: Decompression leg after the placement, self-driven and flexible — good for absorbing what you just did.
food_drink_pick: Knysna oysters; biltong for the drive
best_time: Southern right whales off Hermanus roughly Jun–Nov, viewable from the cliff path for free.

specific_attraction: Humayun's Tomb, Qutub Minar, Jama Masjid, Chandni Chowk rickshaw, Lodhi Gardens
why_worth_it: Humayun's Tomb is the architectural prototype for the Taj Mahal — seeing it first makes Agra read completely differently.
food_drink_pick: Chandni Chowk: paratha at Paranthe Wali Gali, jalebi, chaat; butter chicken at Moti Mahal
best_time: Do Humayun's Tomb before Agra. It's a deliberate sequencing choice and it pays off.

specific_attraction: Taj Mahal at sunrise, Agra Fort, Mehtab Bagh across the river, Fatehpur Sikri en route to Jaipur
why_worth_it: The Taj at sunrise, with the marble changing colour as the light arrives, is one of very few sights that genuinely exceeds its reputation.
food_drink_pick: Mughlai food; petha (Agra's candied gourd sweet)
best_time: Taj is CLOSED on Fridays. Buy tickets online in advance; the sunrise slot requires being at the gate before opening. Mehtab Bagh gives the across-the-river view at sunset.

route: Agra → Jaipur (via Fatehpur Sikri, Chand Baori)
specific_attraction: Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, City Palace, Jantar Mantar, Panna Meena ka Kund stepwell, Nahargarh sunset
why_worth_it: Jantar Mantar is a park of monumental 18th-century astronomical instruments, including the world's largest stone sundial — accurate to about two seconds. For an EE brain it's the most interesting thing in Rajasthan.
food_drink_pick: Laal maas, dal baati churma, lassi at Lassiwala
best_time: Chand Baori stepwell (3,500 symmetrical steps) is on the Agra–Jaipur road and is one of India's most striking structures. Don't skip it.

specific_attraction: Dawn boat on the Ganges, Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat, the old-city lanes, Sarnath
why_worth_it: The dawn boat along the ghats, with the city waking to bathing and ritual, is the most extraordinary hour of travel in India. Sarnath is where the Buddha gave his first sermon.
food_drink_pick: Kachori sabzi breakfast, Banarasi paan, malaiyo in winter
best_time: Photography near the cremation ghats is prohibited and enforced by families and staff — put the camera away entirely there. Solo-version item; the partner route cuts Varanasi by default.

specific_attraction: Rova (Queen's Palace) hilltop, Analakely market, Lemurs' Park
why_worth_it: Tana is mostly a transit base. One afternoon at the Rova for the view over the rice paddies and the tiered hillside city.
food_drink_pick: Romazava (national beef and greens stew), zebu steak, THB beer
best_time: Do not walk in Tana after dark. Arrange transfers through your hotel or operator.

specific_attraction: Indri tracking at dawn, Mantadia rainforest, Vakona lemur island, guided night walk for chameleons and mouse lemurs
why_worth_it: The indri is the largest living lemur and its territorial call carries several kilometres through the forest at dawn. Hearing it is genuinely unlike any other wildlife experience.
food_drink_pick: Lodge-cooked Malagasy food; Madagascan vanilla and chocolate to bring home
best_time: Park entry requires a licensed local guide — this is mandatory, not optional, and the guides are genuinely excellent. Book night walks separately; they run on the reserve edges rather than inside the national park.

specific_attraction: Red Fort, Jama Masjid, Humayun's Tomb, Chandni Chowk, Nizamuddin Dargah qawwali on Thursday evening
why_worth_it: Thursday-evening qawwali at Nizamuddin Dargah is live devotional music in a 700-year-old Sufi shrine, and it is free.
food_drink_pick: Karim's near Jama Masjid; paratha at Paranthe Wali Gali; nihari breakfast
best_time: The Mughal sequencing matters: Humayun's Tomb → Taj → Lahore Fort reads as one continuous architectural argument.

specific_attraction: Taj Mahal at sunrise, Agra Fort, Itmad-ud-Daulah ('Baby Taj'), Mehtab Bagh at sunset
why_worth_it: Itmad-ud-Daulah is the first Mughal structure built entirely in white marble with pietra dura inlay — the direct technical predecessor of the Taj, and almost empty.
food_drink_pick: Mughlai kebabs; petha
best_time: Taj closed Fridays. Book online; sunrise slot only.

specific_attraction: Golden Temple (day and night), the langar kitchen, Jallianwala Bagh, Wagah border ceremony
why_worth_it: The Golden Temple's langar serves free meals to 50,000–100,000 people a day regardless of faith, and volunteers wash the dishes in shifts. Volunteering for an hour is welcomed and is the best way to understand the place.
food_drink_pick: Amritsari kulcha, chole, lassi at Gian di Lassi; the langar dal itself
best_time: Head covering required, shoes removed, free shoe deposit. The temple is open 24h and is at its most beautiful around 04:00 and after dark.

transport: Wagah crossing IF OPEN, else Delhi → Lahore by air
specific_attraction: Lahore Fort, Badshahi Mosque, Wazir Khan Mosque, Walled City, Shalimar Gardens, Food Street
why_worth_it: Wazir Khan Mosque's tilework is arguably the finest surviving Mughal-era faience anywhere, and it sits in a working bazaar rather than a tourist zone.
food_drink_pick: Lahori nihari, paye, Butt Karahi, kulfi on Food Street with the Badshahi Mosque lit behind
best_time: Entry mode is contingent on border status and visa port-of-entry conditions. Arrange a local guide through your hotel. CHECK CURRENT ADVISORY before committing.

specific_attraction: Faisal Mosque, Margalla Hills viewpoint, Taxila archaeological site (Gandharan Buddhist)
why_worth_it: Taxila is a major Gandharan Buddhist archaeological complex — Greek-influenced Buddhist sculpture from the Indo-Greek and Kushan periods. Genuinely world-class and almost unvisited.
food_drink_pick: Chapli kabab; Peshawari karahi; green tea
best_time: CHECK CURRENT ADVISORY. Islamabad is generally the most straightforward city in Pakistan for foreign visitors, but arrange ground transport through your hotel.

specific_attraction: Sydney Opera House (a guided interior tour, not just the exterior photo), Sydney Harbour Bridge climb, Bondi to Coogee coastal walk
why_worth_it: One of the most photographed buildings on earth from outside, but the guided interior tour of the shell structure is what most visitors skip.
food_drink_pick: Fish and chips at Bondi
best_time: Sep to Nov and Mar to May for mild weather

specific_attraction: Uluru base walk at sunrise, Field of Light art installation, a guided Anangu cultural walk
why_worth_it: Climbing Uluru itself has been banned since 2019 out of respect for its Anangu owners; the base walk and cultural tours are the respectful way to experience it now.
best_time: Apr to Sep for cooler desert temperatures

specific_attraction: A liveaboard or day boat snorkel or dive trip to the outer reef, Daintree Rainforest day trip
why_worth_it: The largest living structure on Earth, though coral bleaching events have affected sections in recent years; VERIFY current reef health reports for your chosen operator's site before booking.
food_drink_pick: Fresh barramundi
best_time: Jun to Oct for the best visibility and lowest stinger jellyfish risk
